mapper.insert: INSERT INTO print_jobs (order_id, type, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{type}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT pj.print_job_id AS printJobId, pj.order_id AS orderId, pj.type AS type, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.total_price AS totalPrice, pj.status AS status FROM print_jobs pj JOIN orders o ON pj.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pj.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY pj.print_job_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.menu_name AS menuName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder FROM order_items oi JOIN menus m ON oi.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE print_jobs SET status = 'COMPLETED', result = #{result}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE print_job_id = #{printJobId}
